name: webchanges/webchanges-connector
description: Connect WordPress to any MCP-compatible AI client so agents can manage content, blocks, media, SEO, forms, and site settings over the Model Context Protocol.
_comment: The vendor/ directory (Jetpack autoloader, Plugin Update Checker, MCP Adapter) is committed and bundled with releases. Do NOT run `composer install` / `composer update` against this file — it would clobber the pinned, Jetpack-autoloaded vendor tree the plugin ships with.
